title: One person under two identifiers must not be read as two people, and must not overwrite
notes: Judgement call. v0.1 has no entity-resolution step, so the two subjects (user:alice and employee:E-1042) are NOT bound together and the system correctly keeps two claims rather than one. The fixture asserts the mechanically true outcome — both observations accepted, neither superseded — and deliberately does not assert an alias. Wiring entity_aliases into the resolver is future work; when it lands this fixture's expectations should gain an explicit alias assertion.
